title: A DEAD HOWLER LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Howler left the generic brown wreck. It now leaves its own: the splayed legs buckled under a cracked hull, the turret ring knocked askew, the fat mortar tube snapped off on the ground with its ochre muzzle ring, the ammo drum rolled clear. Smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Howler leaves a smoking mortar wreck.
